finding.wildcard_dns.external_cname: A DNS wildcard (*.{zone}) points to a third-party service ({cname}): any imaginary subdomain can be claimed at that provider. Replace the wildcard with specific records.
module.wildcard_dns.checks: Resolves random names of the domain (A and AAAA) to learn whether a DNS wildcard (*.domain) answers any name, and with which addresses or CNAME.
module.wildcard_dns.fix:
Find out whether the wildcard is intended: `dig +short unknown-name-12345.example.com` returns an address or an alias if a `*.example.com` record exists in the zone.
If you have no use for it: delete the `*` record (A, AAAA or CNAME) from the DNS zone and create a specific record for each subdomain actually in use.
If the wildcard is a CNAME to a third-party service (the case in the finding): replace it right away with specific records; otherwise anyone can claim an imaginary name under your domain at that provider and publish content there.
If the wildcard is essential (an application that creates one subdomain per customer, for example): point it to your own servers, never to a service that accepts any name, and have the application reject unknown names.
In the console of each third-party service you use, attach only the expected names to your account, and enable domain ownership verification when the provider offers it.
Under a wildcard, a name resolving does not prove it exists: to inventory your subdomains, start from the list of records in the zone, not from DNS answers.
Check, once the TTL has passed: a non-existent name must answer `status: NXDOMAIN`; then run the scan again.
module.wildcard_dns.fix_snippet:
# DNS
www.example.com.    3600 IN A     203.0.113.10
app.example.com.    3600 IN A     203.0.113.10
api.example.com.    3600 IN AAAA  2001:db8::1

# Bash
dig unknown-name-12345.example.com | grep "status:"
module.wildcard_dns.title: DNS wildcard
module.wildcard_dns.why: Under a wildcard every name "exists": subdomain enumeration becomes misleading, and a wildcard pointing to a third-party service widens the takeover risk.
wildcard_dns.query_failed: All DNS queries on {zone} failed: wildcard cannot be measured
